text:
kyle: Heads-up — EOD cutover for dedicated GPU pool tonight at 19:00 PT. We'll apply the autoscale policy change (reduce min-size from 6 -> 4, allow 2-node burst). Need owners for smoke checks, rollback readiness, and monitoring handoff.

anika: I'm available for the smoke window. I'll run the perf smoke and KV-cache sanity. ETA 19:05-19:10. @kyle please share the rollout CIDR and the canary slice name.

kyle: Canary slice is `gpu-dedicated-canary-eod-1`. CIDR for temporary burst egress stays the same (10.12.0.0/16). I'll post the cutover checklist in a sec.

marco: I'll own rollback. If we see error rate > 2% or 95th latency regresses by > 150ms, we roll back to previous policy. I'll prepare the rollback runbook and keep `kubectl` access ready.

tess: QA note — I'll validate a sample of customer traffic using the internal smoke harness (`./scripts/smoke --slice gpu-dedicated-canary-eod-1`) and validate embeddings/e2e generation on 10 prompts. I'll post results in-thread.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: `autopolicy-v2.3` -> `gpu-pool/dedicated`. start=2474006800 (19:00 PT), expected-dur=12m. Notifying oncall.

anika: Smoke commands I'll run:
```
# verify model warmup
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-lite","prompt":"warmup"}'
# check KV cache hit-rate
go run ./tools/kvcheck --slice gpu-dedicated-canary-eod-1
```

kyle: Rollback plan (short):
- Abort rollout in console
- Reassign traffic to `gpu-dedicated-stable` slice
- Undo autoscale params via `infra/ops/runbook/rollback-autoscale.sh` (I'll paste link)

marco: Ready. I've created a temporary alert on paging channel if error > 2%: #eng-oncall. I'm also keeping a snapshot of metrics at t0.

tess: I'll post smoke results within 10m of cutover. If anything flakey, :x: hold and quick postmortem.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Canary window requires 10 successful health checks before traffic ramp. Health check interval=30s.

kyle: Thanks all — final checks by 18:40 PT. Ping me with any blockers. :thumbsup:
